name: Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides futures brokerage business in China and internationally. The company is also involved in asset management, securities, fund sales, financial, and lending business. It also provides basis trading, over-the-counter derivatives, and market making services. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Yongan Futures Brokerage Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd. in September 2012. Yongan Futures Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
